questions.q: Statement: The company's new policy states that employees must complete a mandatory cybersecurity training program before accessing the corporate network. Assumptions: I. Employees who have not completed the training may pose a security risk to the network. II. The training program is comprehensive enough to prevent all cyber attacks.
opts: Neither I nor II is implicit
Both I and II are implicit
questions.why: The rule assumes untrained staff are a risk; 'prevent all attacks' is too absolute. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: In a group of 40 people, 19 like cricket, 22 like football and 16 like neither. How many like only cricket?
questions.why: Both = 19 + 22 − (40 − 16) = 17; only cricket = 19 − 17 = 2. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Five officers P, Q, R, S and T sit in a row facing north. R sits exactly in the middle. P sits to the immediate left of R. T does not sit at either end. Q does not sit next to P. Who sits at the extreme right end?
questions.why: R is third and P second. T is not at an end, so T is fourth. Q cannot sit next to P, so Q is fifth and S is first. The order is S, P, R, T, Q.

The present ages of Deepak and Asha are in the ratio 6 : 5. After 4 years the ratio will be 13 : 11. What is Asha's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 6k and 5k: (6k + 4)/(5k + 4) = 13/11 gives k = 8, so Asha is 40. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Item A costs ₹3.20 in 2008 and rises 50 paise a year; item B costs ₹5.30 and rises 25 paise a year. In which year will A cost 40 paise more than B?
questions.why: The gap closes 25 paise a year from −₹2.10 to +₹0.40: 2.50 ÷ 0.25 = 10 years → 2018. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2023.

questions.q: Statement: Should defence attorneys be allowed to take part entirely by video-conference in all criminal trials? Arguments: I. Yes. It will lower the cost of legal representation and speed up disposal of cases. II. No. It compromises the right to effective legal assistance, as confidential consultation and real-time cross-examination cannot be replicated over digital links.
opts: Neither I nor II is strong
Both I and II are strong
questions.why: II rests on a fundamental right; I is a convenience. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.
